audit_event_seal_check.name: audit_event_seal_check
audit_event_seal_check.value:
("audit_event"."seq" is null and "audit_event"."prev_hash" is null and "audit_event"."hash" is null)
        or ("audit_event"."seq" is not null and "audit_event"."prev_hash" is not null and "audit_event"."hash" is not null)

charge_void_check.name: charge_void_check
charge_void_check.value:
("charge"."status" = 'voided') = ("charge"."void_reason" is not null)
        and ("charge"."status" = 'voided') = ("charge"."voided_at" is not null)

charge_review_check.name: charge_review_check
charge_review_check.value: ("needs_review") = ("review_reason" is not null) and ("needs_review") = ("flagged_at" is not null) and ("review_reason" is null or "review_reason" in ('no_show', 'cancelled'))

cash_session_close_check.name: cash_session_close_check
cash_session_close_check.value:
("cash_session"."status" = 'closed') = ("cash_session"."closed_at" is not null)
        and ("cash_session"."status" = 'closed') = ("cash_session"."closed_by" is not null)
        and ("cash_session"."status" = 'closed') = ("cash_session"."expected_cents" is not null)
        and ("cash_session"."status" = 'closed') = ("cash_session"."counted_cents" is not null)
        and ("cash_session"."status" = 'closed') = ("cash_session"."difference_cents" is not null)

payment_reference_key.name: payment_reference_key
payment_reference_key.where: "payment"."external_ref" is not null and "payment"."override_reason" is null

payment_reference_length_check.name: payment_reference_length_check
payment_reference_length_check.value: "payment"."external_ref" is null or length(btrim("payment"."external_ref")) between 1 and 64

clinical_note_state_check.name: clinical_note_state_check
clinical_note_state_check.value:
(
        ("clinical_note"."status" = 'draft'
          and "clinical_note"."signed_at" is null
          and "clinical_note"."error_reason_enc" is null and "clinical_note"."error_marked_by" is null
          and "clinical_note"."error_marked_at" is null)
        or ("clinical_note"."status" = 'signed'
          and "clinical_note"."signed_at" is not null
          and "clinical_note"."draft_content_enc" is null
          and "clinical_note"."error_reason_enc" is null and "clinical_note"."error_marked_by" is null
          and "clinical_note"."error_marked_at" is null)
        or ("clinical_note"."status" = 'entered_in_error'
          and "clinical_note"."error_reason_enc" is not null
          and "clinical_note"."error_marked_by" is not null and "clinical_note"."error_marked_at" is not null
          and "clinical_note"."draft_content_enc" is null)
      )

patient_coverage_dates_check.name: patient_coverage_dates_check
patient_coverage_dates_check.value: "patient_coverage"."valid_from" is null or "patient_coverage"."valid_to" is null or "patient_coverage"."valid_to" >= "patient_coverage"."valid_from"

patient_coverage_end_check.name: patient_coverage_end_check
patient_coverage_end_check.value: ("patient_coverage"."ended_at" is null) = ("patient_coverage"."end_reason" is null) and ("patient_coverage"."end_reason" is null or "patient_coverage"."end_reason" in ('replaced', 'removed'))

document_replaces_live_key.name: document_replaces_live_key
document_replaces_live_key.where: "document"."replaces_document_id" is not null and "document"."status" <> 'rejected' and "document"."abandoned_at" is null

document_available_check.name: document_available_check
document_available_check.value: "document"."status" not in ('available', 'hidden') or ("document"."sha256" is not null and "document"."content_type" is not null)

document_hidden_check.name: document_hidden_check
document_hidden_check.value: "document"."status" <> 'hidden' or ("document"."hidden_at" is not null and "document"."hidden_by" is not null and "document"."hidden_reason" is not null)

invoice_delivery_state_check.name: invoice_delivery_state_check
invoice_delivery_state_check.value: ("status" = 'pending') = ("delivery_state" is not null) and ("delivery_state" is null or "delivery_state" in ('queued', 'retrying', 'awaiting_reconciliation', 'needs_attention'))

invoice_voucher_check.name: invoice_voucher_check
invoice_voucher_check.value: ("status" in ('issued', 'manual')) = ("number" is not null) and ("status" in ('issued', 'manual')) = ("cae" is not null) and ("number" is null or "number" > 0) and ("cae" is null or "cae" ~ '^[0-9]{14}$') and ("status" <> 'issued' or "cae_expires_on" is not null) and ("status" in ('issued', 'manual') or ("cae_expires_on" is null and "issued_at" is null))

invoice_recipient_kind_check.name: invoice_recipient_kind_check
invoice_recipient_kind_check.value:
("invoice"."recipient_kind" = 'patient' and "invoice"."patient_id" is not null and "invoice"."tenant_payer_id" is null)
        or ("invoice"."recipient_kind" = 'payer' and "invoice"."tenant_payer_id" is not null and "invoice"."patient_id" is null)

invoice_recipient_document_check.name: invoice_recipient_document_check
invoice_recipient_document_check.value: ("recipient_doc_type" is null) = ("recipient_doc_number" is null) and ("recipient_doc_type" is null or "recipient_doc_type" in ('cuit', 'dni'))

invoice_credit_note_check.name: invoice_credit_note_check
invoice_credit_note_check.value: ("type" in ('NCA', 'NCB', 'NCC')) = ("credit_note_of_id" is not null) and ("credit_note_of_id" is null or ("reason" is not null and length(btrim("reason")) > 0))

invoice_document_delivery_check.name: invoice_document_delivery_check
invoice_document_delivery_check.value: not ("invoice_document"."delivered_at" is not null and "invoice_document"."delivery_skipped_reason" is not null)

local_afip_request_shape_check.name: local_afip_request_shape_check
local_afip_request_shape_check.value:
("local_afip_request"."outcome" = 'authorized') = ("local_afip_request"."voucher_id" is not null)
          and ("local_afip_request"."outcome" = 'rejected') = ("local_afip_request"."message" is not null)

message_cancel_reason_check.name: message_cancel_reason_check
message_cancel_reason_check.value: ("status" = 'cancelled') = ("cancel_reason" is not null) and ("cancel_reason" is null or "cancel_reason" in ('tenant_read_only', 'demo_tenant', 'opted_out', 'appointment_changed', 'appointment_cancelled', 'appointment_over', 'integration_off', 'quota_exhausted', 'no_channel', 'offer_expired', 'video_link_unavailable'))

message_failure_reason_check.name: message_failure_reason_check
message_failure_reason_check.value: ("status" = 'failed') = ("failure_reason" is not null) and ("failure_reason" is null or "failure_reason" in ('not_on_whatsapp', 'template_rejected', 'invalid_number', 'mailbox_unavailable', 'delivery_failed', 'retries_exhausted'))

message_offer_url_idx.name: message_offer_url_idx
message_offer_url_idx.where: "message_offer"."url_enc" is not null or "message_offer"."url" is not null

platform_audit_event_seal_check.name: platform_audit_event_seal_check
platform_audit_event_seal_check.value:
("platform_audit_event"."seq" is null and "platform_audit_event"."prev_hash" is null and "platform_audit_event"."hash" is null)
        or ("platform_audit_event"."seq" is not null and "platform_audit_event"."prev_hash" is not null and "platform_audit_event"."hash" is not null)

patient_representative_contact_check.name: patient_representative_contact_check
patient_representative_contact_check.value: "patient_representative"."phone" is not null or "patient_representative"."email" is not null

patient_rights_request_fulfilled_check.name: patient_rights_request_fulfilled_check
patient_rights_request_fulfilled_check.value: ("patient_rights_request"."status" = 'fulfilled') = ("patient_rights_request"."fulfilled_at" is not null and "patient_rights_request"."fulfilled_by" is not null)

professional_hours_exception_interval_ch.name: professional_hours_exception_interval_check
professional_hours_exception_interval_ch.value:
("professional_hours_exception"."location_id" is null and "professional_hours_exception"."weekday" is null and "professional_hours_exception"."start_minute" is null and "professional_hours_exception"."end_minute" is null)
        or ("professional_hours_exception"."location_id" is not null and "professional_hours_exception"."weekday" is not null
            and "professional_hours_exception"."start_minute" is not null and "professional_hours_exception"."end_minute" is not null
            and "professional_hours_exception"."weekday" between 1 and 7 and "professional_hours_exception"."start_minute" >= 0 and "professional_hours_exception"."end_minute" <= 1440 and "professional_hours_exception"."end_minute" > "professional_hours_exception"."start_minute")

schedule_block_scope_check.name: schedule_block_scope_check
schedule_block_scope_check.value: "schedule_block"."professional_id" is not null or "schedule_block"."location_id" is not null

professional_verified_check.name: professional_verified_check
professional_verified_check.value: "professional"."matricula_status" = 'unverified' or ("professional"."matricula" is not null and "professional"."verified_by_operator" is not null)

video_session_reason_matches_status_chec.name: video_session_reason_matches_status_check
video_session_reason_matches_status_chec.value:
("video_session"."status" = 'link_pending') = ("video_session"."pending_reason" is not null)
        and ("video_session"."status" = 'closed') = ("video_session"."close_reason" is not null)

video_session_opened_order_check.name: video_session_opened_order_check
video_session_opened_order_check.value:
"video_session"."last_opened_at" is null
        or ("video_session"."first_opened_at" is not null and "video_session"."last_opened_at" >= "video_session"."first_opened_at")

waitlist_entry_close_check.name: waitlist_entry_close_check
waitlist_entry_close_check.value: ("status" = 'closed') = ("close_reason" is not null) and ("status" = 'closed') = ("closed_at" is not null) and ("close_reason" is null or "close_reason" in ('fulfilled', 'expired', 'cancelled', 'patient_opted_out'))

waitlist_entry_manual_check.name: waitlist_entry_manual_check
waitlist_entry_manual_check.value: ("manual_contact_only") = ("manual_reason" is not null) and ("manual_reason" is null or "manual_reason" in ('no_offers_opt_in', 'no_reachable_channel', 'patient_opted_out', 'undeliverable'))

waitlist_entry_opt_in_check.name: waitlist_entry_opt_in_check
waitlist_entry_opt_in_check.value: ("offers_opt_in_at" is null) = ("offers_opt_in_source" is null) and ("offers_opt_in_source" is null or "offers_opt_in_source" in ('staff', 'public_join')) and ("offers_opt_in_source" is distinct from 'staff' or "offers_opt_in_by" is not null)

waitlist_entry_dates_check.name: waitlist_entry_dates_check
waitlist_entry_dates_check.value: "waitlist_entry"."earliest_date" is null or "waitlist_entry"."latest_date" is null or "waitlist_entry"."earliest_date" <= "waitlist_entry"."latest_date"

waitlist_offer_end_check.name: waitlist_offer_end_check
waitlist_offer_end_check.value: ("status" = 'open') = ("closed_at" is null) and ("end_reason" is null or "end_reason" in ('slot_taken', 'slot_unavailable', 'undeliverable', 'patient_opted_out', 'entry_closed'))

worklist_item_resolution_check.name: worklist_item_resolution_check
worklist_item_resolution_check.value:
("worklist_item"."status" = 'open' and "worklist_item"."resolved_at" is null and "worklist_item"."resolved_by" is null)
        or ("worklist_item"."status" <> 'open' and "worklist_item"."resolved_at" is not null and "worklist_item"."resolved_by" is not null)
